title: MD-Arm-T1 per-arm 5 V power and U2D2 TTL netlist

nets.name: ARM_5V_RAW
nets.purpose: Independent per-arm regulated supply before manual disconnect

nets.name: ARM_GND
nets.purpose: Arm power return and TTL signal reference

U2D2_TTL.note: The U2D2-specific official pinout labels TTL pin 2 N/C. ROBOTIS also states U2D2 does not supply DYNAMIXEL power. External VDD is injected only by protected actuator branches.

design_notes: Duplicate this complete netlist for the second arm with a second PSU and U2D2.
A common mechanical e-stop actuator may operate two correctly rated independent poles.
Fuse values, wire gauges, connector current limits, distribution PCB creepage, and e-stop component ratings remain blocked pending component selection and bench measurements.
Loss of arm power does not remove USB power from U2D2; software must not assume the adapter disappearing proves e-stop operation.
